DssSpellAction instance deployed by and referenced from the DssSpell contract.
block.timestamp / now: miner-influenced time source used for office-hour gating, scheduling and cast-time computation.
External entry point of DssAction guarded by the limited modifier; delegates to actions().
DssSpellAction.actions() override performing all spell operations: collateral onboarding, oracle whitelisting, changelog updates.
limited modifier: enforces weekday and 14:00-21:00 UTC window derived from block.timestamp.
internal libcall(bytes) which delegatecalls arbitrary calldata into the immutable lib address.
internal helper resolving a bytes32 key to an address through the Chainlog contract.
internal helper resolving an ilk to its Flipper address via the ILK_REGISTRY.
internal routine performing complete collateral onboarding from a CollateralOpts struct.
internal routine adding the minimal collateral wiring to the system.
DssExec.schedule(): sets eta = now + pause.delay() then calls pause.plot externally.
DssExec.cast(): sets done = true then calls pause.exec externally.
DssExec.nextCastTime(): computes the next valid cast time from eta and block.timestamp.
DssExec.officeHours(): external view forwarding to SpellAction(action).officeHours().
DssExec constructor: resolves MCD_PAUSE, stores action/expiration/description, derives tag from extcodehash.
DssSpell constructor: deploys DssSpellAction and schedules DssExec with now + 30 days.

Low-level delegatecall of calldata into the immortal lib address; executes library code in the spell's storage context.
External view call ChainlogLike(LOG).getAddress(key) whose return value is consumed as a trusted contract address.
External state-changing call ChainlogAbstract_2(LOG).removeAddress('FAUCET') issued directly from the spell.
External call PauseAbstract(pause).plot(action, tag, sig, eta) invoked after the eta state update.
External call PauseAbstract(pause).exec(action, tag, sig, eta) which ultimately triggers the spell action's delegatecall.
External view calls LPOracle(UNIV2ETHUSDT_PIP).orb0()/orb1() whose results are whitelisted as median readers.
External view call SpellAction(action).officeHours() against an attacker-influenceable action address.
External call RegistryLike(reg()).ilkData(ilk) returning a tuple whose flip entry is used as an address.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is divided by 1 days/1 hours to compute day and hour, gating whether execute() can be cast.
nextCastTime derives castTime from block.timestamp and eta, so the resulting schedule depends on miner-controllable time.
schedule() uses now for the expiration check and computes eta = now + pause.delay().
DssSpell constructor uses now + 30 days as the spell expiration timestamp.
The limited modifier is the only access gate wrapping the external execute() entry point.
execute() unconditionally forwards control to the overridden actions() implementation.
actions() invokes addNewCollateral for UNIV2DAIUSDC-A and UNIV2ETHUSDT-A.
actions() directly calls Chainlog.removeAddress("FAUCET") on the changelog contract.
actions() reads orb0()/orb1() from the LP oracle before whitelisting them on the medianizers.
actions() writes the new collateral addresses into the changelog via setChangelogAddress.
actions() bumps the changelog version to 1.2.5 via setChangelogVersion.
addNewCollateral first wires the base collateral via addCollateralBase.
addNewCollateral authorizes FlipperMom/OsmMom on the new flip and pip contracts.
addNewCollateral deauthorizes FlipperMom when the collateral is not liquidatable.
addNewCollateral sets the ilk debt ceiling from co.ilkDebtCeiling.
addNewCollateral raises the global debt ceiling by the ilk ceiling.
addNewCollateral sets the ilk stability fee from co.ilkStabilityFee.
addNewCollateral sets the ilk min vault amount (dust) from co.minVaultAmount.
addNewCollateral finishes by refreshing the ilk spot price.
addCollateralBase builds an abi-encoded payload and forwards it to libcall.
libcall performs the low-level delegatecall into the lib address with caller-supplied data.
libcall reads the immutable lib state variable as the delegatecall destination.
getChangelogAddress issues the external getAddress call used to resolve all core module addresses.
getChangelogAddress reads the constant LOG address as the Chainlog target.
flip performs an external ilkData() call on the ILK_REGISTRY to derive the Flipper address.
schedule() makes an external callback into the pause proxy via plot() after updating eta, giving the callee control.
schedule() reads the immutable pause state variable to query delay() and call plot().
cast() makes an external callback into the pause proxy via exec(); the done flag is set beforehand which mitigates re-entry.
cast() writes the done guard state variable before performing the external call.
officeHours() performs an external static call to the spell action's officeHours() implementation.
The DssExec constructor resolves MCD_PAUSE by calling getAddress on the Chainlog.
The constructor assigns the immutable action state variable from the _spellAction argument.
The constructor assigns the immutable pause state variable from the Chainlog lookup.
The constructor assigns the immutable expiration state variable.
The constructor derives the immutable tag from extcodehash(_action) in inline assembly.
The constructor stores the abi.encodeWithSignature("execute()") selector into sig.
The DssSpell constructor passes the deployed spell instance description and address to DssExec.
The DssSpell constructor uses now to compute the expiration passed into DssExec.
setChangelogAddress encodes a call and hands it to libcall for delegateexecution.
setChangelogVersion encodes a call and hands it to libcall for delegateexecution.
authorize forwards an encoded authorization call to libcall.
deauthorize forwards an encoded deauthorization call to libcall.
setIlkDebtCeiling forwards an encoded call to libcall.
increaseGlobalDebtCeiling forwards an encoded call to libcall.
setIlkStabilityFee forwards an encoded call to libcall.
setIlkMinVaultAmount forwards an encoded call to libcall.
updateCollateralPrice forwards an encoded call to libcall.
The CollateralOpts parameter supplies ilk, gem, join, flip, pip and all risk parameters consumed by addNewCollateral.
The data parameter is the raw payload passed straight into lib.delegatecall.
The bytes32 key parameter is forwarded to ChainlogLike(LOG).getAddress.
The ilk parameter is forwarded to RegistryLike(reg()).ilkData.
The UNIV2DAIUSDC_A struct literal is the argument passed into addNewCollateral.
The UNIV2ETHUSDT_A struct literal is the argument passed into addNewCollateral.
day is computed as (block.timestamp / 1 days + 3) % 7 and checked with require(day < 5).
hour is computed as block.timestamp / 1 hours % 24 and required to be within 14..20.
The castTime local is adjusted with day/hour/minute/second arithmetic and returned.
_tag is populated inside the constructor assembly block and assigned to the immutable tag.
_spellAction is written into the immutable action state variable.
_action mirrors _spellAction for extcodehash assembly access in the constructor.
The version string parameter is abi-encoded into the delegatecall payload of setChangelogVersion.

normalization_plan.reason: The bytes payload is only meaningful as the delegatecall input of libcall; it should be folded into the libcall node.
The key parameter exists solely as the lookup index inside getChangelogAddress.
The ilk parameter is only consumed by the Registry lookup performed inside flip.
The CollateralOpts struct is the single argument that drives every action of addNewCollateral.
The temporary struct is constructed only to be immediately consumed by addNewCollateral.
The temporary struct is constructed only to be immediately consumed by addNewCollateral.
day is a throwaway weekday computation local inside the limited modifier.
hour is a throwaway hour computation local inside the limited modifier.
castTime is the return accumulator of nextCastTime and has no independent meaning.
_tag is an assembly scratch local used only to populate the immutable tag in the constructor.
_spellAction is consumed by the constructor to set action and compute the code hash.
_action is a duplicate alias of the constructor argument used only for assembly access.
The version string is only abi-encoded into the libcall payload issued by setChangelogVersion.
